items.title: Being finite locally free, with or without prescribed degree, is fpqc local on the base
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file descent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts fpqc locality on the base both for 'finite locally free' and, for each d >= 0, for 'finite locally free of degree d' (statement lines 6441-6448). For the first, the proof decomposes the property into finiteness, flatness and local finite presentation by the equivalence with finite flat locally finitely presented morphisms, and quotes the three corresponding descending lemmas. For the second it gives a displayed reason rather than a citation: if a finite locally free f becomes of degree d after a surjective family of base changes, then d can be read off at a point u from the fibre (f_* O_Z)_u tensor kappa(u), which is computed after base change and is therefore d everywhere (proof lines 6450-6462). The level is H2: one part is an assembly of three already-established descent statements and the other is a short displayed computation of the degree.
